title: Deep Learning
intro: Begin with linear decision boundaries and gradient updates, then use neural networks for image classification, regression, segmentation and detection. The final assignment compares sequence forecasts with simple baselines.

chapters.title: Linear classifiers and gradient descent
chapters.summary: Find a decision boundary by grid search, then learn its parameters through gradients.

chapters.title: Backpropagation and dense networks
chapters.summary: Trace derivatives through a neuron and inspect training on handwritten digits.

chapters.title: Convolutions and shape classification
chapters.summary: Count convolutional parameters and compare filters learned from upright and rotated shapes.

chapters.title: Reading clocks and counting triangles
chapters.summary: Choose prediction targets and errors that match two image-regression tasks.

chapters.title: Segmentation and object detection
chapters.summary: Compare prompted pixel masks with labeled bounding boxes on selected images.

chapters.title: Sequence forecasting and baselines
chapters.summary: Evaluate airline and Bitcoin forecasts in chronological test periods.
